spots.name: Scheepjes
spots.blurb: You've reached Scheepjes, a street art piece by Unknown. Several scale model boats float freely in the pond relying on wind and occasional passerby attention. Wind power is never a problem, it plenty of wind in the Netherlands.

spots.name: Sunday extroversion
tags: artist: Roos de Jong, Winand Slingenbergh, Claudio Tiecher
spots.blurb: You've reached Sunday extroversion, a street art piece by Roos de Jong, Winand Slingenbergh, Claudio Tiecher. Three happy people are drawing and writing messages on the living room window, check out the first floor ;).
